integrity: The exact analytical lower and upper certificates cover all nonnegative integer type counts of total at least two. Finite exact-rational checks and separate unsymmetrized linear programs corroborate but do not replace the proof. Source-comparison incompleteness is acknowledged.

title: Exact least-core deficit in a binary plurality-voting ensemble
